newsitem.title: CANADA: Southern Africa up on results speculation.
newsitem.headline: Southern Africa up on results speculation.

text.p: Southern Africa Minerals Corp, a Toronto-based diamond and base metals exploration company, was up in heavy trading Friday.
"I believe people are starting to speculate on results coming out in September," said Southern Africa spokesman Jonathan Armes.
Shares were up C$0.15 to C$1.40 on Friday morning, the highest they've been since March 1. More than 385,000 shares traded hands.
The company is currently exploring its diamond prospect in Botswana, said Armes.
And BHP Minerals Canada Ltd is drilling at its base metals joint-venture property with Southern Africa Minerals in Matagami, Quebec, he said.
Results are expected in a couple of weeks, he added.
